column6: Ten-odd years after the death of the king of Rikistria...
The disasters that struck again and again
were enough to sow new fear in a people
who had found brief relief at the king's death...
Traujito, the town of ruins in Rikistria,
once the scene of turmoil,
fell to a great earthquake.
The town lay buried in rubble.
Those who knew the turmoil feared the king had returned,
and some even began to say they had seen him.
The Republic's council took stock of the damage
and sent a survey team back into the labyrinth,
sealed for ten-odd years.
The survey leader had one family member: his son.
An envoy sent by the state came to the son.
The envoy said only that the survey leader
had died on duty in the labyrinth.
The young man pressed him for details,
but the envoy left without a word.
The next morning, the young man left home.
His steps led to Traujito, the Holy Land...
